owners.label: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
owners.description:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stacks of Gathered Mind.


After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the Mindlock effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the Gathered Mind effect, gain Gathered Mind with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks.
If Qingxiao already has Gathered Mind and the target's Mindlock stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks, Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks will be matched to the target's Mindlock stacks.


Gathered Mind

After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict Mindlock equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast Tune Break, if the target has Tune Strain - Shifting, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain Gathered Mind, and any existing Gathered Mind effect becomes inactive.
Gathered Mind stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.

owners.label: To Know, To Banish
owners.description:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of Mindlock on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.


Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.

owners.label: Lingering Song
owners.description: Deal Aero DMG equal to 800% of Qingxiao's ATK.

owners.label: Draw and Sunder
owners.description: Qingxiao gains extra damage against Tune Strain - Interfered targets.

owners.label: S1: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart
owners.description:
Crit. Rate is increased by 16%.


The max stack limit of Swordlight Ward is increased to 2. Casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade additionally grants 1 stacks of Swordlight Ward.


Upon entering combat, gain 25 stack of Exorcising Seal.
After Basic Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade, or Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence deals damage, if Qingxiao has Exorcising Seal, remove Exorcising Seal and trigger Juque Perdition, dealing Aero DMG equal to 400% of Qingxiao's ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once per second. For each stack of Exorcising Seal removed, the target takes 4% more DMG from Juque Perdition for 2s.
Exorcising Seal stacks up to 25 times.

owners.label: S2: Like Petals That Fall Without a Sound
owners.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack - Stringblade is increased by 40%.


After entering combat, the max stack limit of Mindlock on nearby enemies is increased to 25.
The max stack limit of Gathered Mind from Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust is increased to 25.


Heaven's Clarity is enhanced:
Casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade now inflicts 6 stack of Mindlock on nearby targets.

owners.label: S3: Dreams Fade, Sword Abides
owners.description:
The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven is increased by 100%.


During Heavy Attack - Stringblade, gain World in Chorus stacks equal to the highest Mindlock stack count present among nearby enemies.
World in Chorus: Each stack increases the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence by 3%. World in Chorus is removed after casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence.


The Gathered Mind effect of Inherent Skill - Sea of Thought, World of Dust now inflicts 2 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered.

owners.label: S4: Wherever the Road Leads, Side by Side
owners.description: After a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, their ATK is increased by 20% for 8s.

owners.label: Cold Steel That Longs to Warm the Snow
owners.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement is increased by 100%.


While moving in Sword Flight, Flight Qi cost is reduced by 30%.

owners.label: S6: Cleanse This Tarnished Age, Till All Runs Clear
owners.description:
Targets take 40% more DMG from Qingxiao's Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven, and Juque Perdition.


During Heavy Attack - Stringblade, gain Exorcising Seal stacks equal to the highest Mindlock stack count present among nearby enemies.


For each stack of Mindlock on the target, the DMG of Juque Perdition taken by the target is Amplified by 2%. The first 7 stack additionally grant 5% DMG Amplification.


When Inherent Skill - To Know, To Banish is unlocked, the DMG of Juque Perdition on targets with Mindlock is increased by 2% for each stack of Mindlock. The first 7 stacks additionally grant 5% DMG increase.


The effect of Qingxiao's response to Tune Strain - Interfered is increased by 20%.

owners.label: Mindlock
owners.description: Qingxiao deals increased damage to targets affected by Mindlock.

owners.label: Ephemeral Transcendence
owners.description: Qingxiao empowers Ephemeral Transcendence attacks before Heaven's Reckoning is unlocked.

owners.label: Heaven's Clarity
owners.description: When casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade, inflict 3 stacks of Mindlock on nearby targets, and enhance the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target.
